name: BLURB
description: BLURB is a comprehensive biomedical NLP benchmark compiled from publicly available datasets to evaluate domain-specific language model pretraining and performance across a wide range of biomedical NLP tasks.
reputation: Widely used in biomedical NLP research with a public leaderboard and released pretrained models.
notes: Focuses on domain-specific pretraining benefits and includes a leaderboard for benchmarking.
